title: Prism: add a dotenv language
prompt: This is a copy of Prism 1.30.0 (the single-file bundle, the per-language components, the loadLanguages helper and the language metadata). Add support for `.env` files as a new language called `dotenv`, also reachable as `env`, so it can be loaded like any other language with the loadLanguages helper and is listed in the language metadata the way other languages are (title `dotenv`, alias `env`). Its grammar uses these top-level token types: `comment` (a `#` comment on its own line, optionally indented), `keyword` (a leading `export` before a variable name), `key` (the variable name, aliased `attr-name`), `punctuation` (the `=`), and `value` (everything after the `=` up to the end of the line, quotes included, aliased `attr-value`). A key may contain dots. Optional whitespace around `=` is allowed and not part of any token.
